INSERT INTO share_links (token_hash, id, workbook_id, role, label, created_by, expires_at, single_use)
             SELECT $3, $4, $1, $5, $6, $2, now() + $7 * interval '1 second', $8
             FROM members WHERE workbook_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND role = 'owner'
             RETURNING id
